You belong to a community, known as the Tany, who traditionally speak the Taneg language.

By now, speakers of Taneg are in the minority. About 20% of the population speaks it regularly, but everyone also speaks English.

You did not grow up speaking it, but your grandparents did, and your parents spoke some, and you have decided to become a speaker!

Press any key to continue.

You think this is an important moment.

Minority languages like this often die out, or are left with only a few enthusiasts keeping them alive.

You, like many Tany people, want to avoid this future for Taneg. And you think the only way to do that is for people like you to learn and use the language.

Press any key to continue.

Today you’ll learn just a small part of the language.

You know that Taneg is quite different from English, so you’ll need to pay careful attention to how it works.

Press any key to continue.

Be part of a bright future for Taneg! You don’t want it to die out…
